newsitem.title: GERMANY: German consumer climate dampens in March - ICON.
newsitem.headline: German consumer climate dampens in March - ICON.

text.p: Consumer confidence in Germany weakened in March, raising concerns that an uptrend over the last six months was coming to an end, economic researcher ICON Wirtschaftsforschung said on Monday.
The ICON consumer confidence index fell two points to 89 as private households for the first time in several months indicted they were saving more and putting off purchases of durable goods.
